POETRY_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for poetry: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

POETRY_HOME.description: Directory where Poetry will be installed. Defaults to ~/.local or %APPDATA%\pypoetry.

POETRY_VERSION.description: Specific version of Poetry to install.

POETRY_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading poetry binary or archive artifacts.

POETRY_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying poetry available remote releases.
